services.name: Player_AlignXToCameraGrid
services.behavior: Rounds PLAYER_WORLD_X to a 0x10-pixel grid position plus 8, converts it to local PLAYER_X using WORLD_CAMERA_X, restores the horizontal threshold to 0xB0, and clears CAMERA_UPDATE_DELAY.

services.name: Player_SelectInteractionAnimation
services.behavior: When PLAYER_INTERACTION_ANIMATION_GATE is clear, indexes the animation-root table at ROM 0x001218D8 with PLAYER_INTERACTION_ANIMATION_INDEX, clears PLAYER_ANIMATION_TIMER, and sets TERRAIN_HORIZONTAL_RESPONSE to 2.

services.name: Player_ResetTerrainMotionState
services.behavior: Selects a response stream from the raw query, SCENE_STATE, and CAMERA_SPECIAL_MODE gates, clears PLAYER_VY and PLAYER_ANIMATION_TIMER, sets TERRAIN_LANDING_STATE to 0xFF, and clears the terrain response timer/latch.

conclusion: The player terrain-response cluster now exposes its coordinate alignment, indexed interaction-animation selection, and reset-state contracts as named services.
